title: Phase 4: Serve organizations with delegated authority
description:
Outcome: chattic.us serves multi-user organizations. People sign in with Google through Cognito, organizations are the unit of enablement and billing, members share channels, bots, and one organization computer, and what a member may approve or see is governed by a delegated authority ceiling modeled on how an office works.

Not included: Apple sign-in, domain-verified auto-join, per-member isolation on the shared computer, billing mechanics.

Design, rejected alternatives, and explicit non-requirements: **docs/ORGANIZATIONS.md**.

## How to work this initiative

Every child issue carries a header naming its phase, what blocks it, what it runs in parallel with, and what it unblocks. **Phases run in sequence. Everything inside a phase runs at the same time.** Filter by the phase-N label to see what is workable now.

| Phase | What happens | Items |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Ground work, nothing blocks it | 79ca6a, 7c1382, 0ab02c, 272aea, 1ebc7d |
| 2 | Cognito and the control plane, two builds that never touch | 0df6cb, b574a6 |
| 3 | Identity resolves, nothing enforces yet | 5f0c4c, fac2ee, 79578e, 5558db, 41d08d |
| 4 | The door closes | 22f5bb, then **7b4616**, then e41552, ae51dc |
| 5 | Collaboration | 14f692, then 6c1a9b, 0814e6, ddf609 |
| 6 | Delegated authority | 24df70, eef4aa, then ac3b7a, b49a89, 14cf05, then e4053a |
| 7 | Environments come back | bc830a, then 89a222 |

**Critical path:** 0ab02c to 0df6cb to 5f0c4c to 22f5bb to 7b4616 to 14f692 to ddf609 to 24df70 to eef4aa to e4053a to bc830a to 89a222. Everything off that line has slack; if capacity is short, staff the path first and let the members CLI, invitations, and named roles arrive late.

**One hard join: 7b4616.** Four phase-3 and phase-4 tracks converge on it and nothing in phases 5 to 7 begins before it. Enforcement flips in a single step because a half-enforced front door is a second authentication path, and this repository does not keep two.

**Two serialize-merge hazards.** 79578e reshapes every route and the tenant column in most feature files; give it a clear window and merge it alone. 6c1a9b, 0814e6, and ddf609 are independent in logic but all edit models.py and messaging/store.py; give the set to one agent or merge them one at a time.

## Rules for every item

- Gherkin first. Scenarios must fail for the right reason before production code exists.
- One correct path. No item ships a second way of doing what it already does.
- Pull requests target develop, reviewed by the sub-agent loop in AGENTS.md.
- AWS resources are CDK only. Organization and membership rows are data and may be written by the members CLI.
- After any deploy-affecting merge, run sh scripts/live_aws_thin_turn.sh development from a logged-in shell. The in-process gates use moto and prove nothing about CloudFront, SQS, or Lambda.
- Secrets never enter the repository, a CDK template, or an agent transcript.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
As an organization adopting Chatticus, I want my people to sign in with Google and share one workplace under delegated authority, so that named teammates can act for the company while only the people with standing can commit it.

Definition of done: no route serves an unauthenticated caller; an organization is enabled as a unit and its owner invites the rest; members share channels, bots, and one organization computer; and every consequential action is bound by the requesting member's authority ceiling. Design recorded in docs/ORGANIZATIONS.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Adversarial pass before implementation, using inversion.** Six issues added and nine existing issues commented. The question asked was how this initiative fails, not how it succeeds.

**Two are hard gates on the phase-4 join and were missing entirely:**

- **5744ef** seed the first organization. Flipping enforcement with an empty membership table locks everyone out of every environment.
- **d71ed5** teach live acceptance and the demo CLI to authenticate. Every phase in this plan ends by running the live script, and the live script does not know how to authenticate.

**Consequence:** 41d08d, the members CLI, is raised to P0. It is the bootstrap path, not a convenience.

**Four more:**

- **3a35db** wire the ceiling into the capability sinks, because eef4aa alone produces a type nothing consults. This repository already split policy from wiring once, in 3c5f8d and 1f3bb8.
- **ac5453** verify the Google consent screen. An unverified External app is capped at 100 users and warns on the consent screen, so the waitlist fails on the day it starts working. Verification needs a privacy policy on the marketing site, a dependency nothing named.
- **694392** cap organization creation and alarm on Cognito monthly active users. Open signup is an intentional unauthenticated write path with no limit on it.
- **349634** signing out actually signs out, because clearing in-memory tokens leaves the Cognito session and the next sign-in silently restores the previous human.

**Themes in the comments:** one-way doors at pool creation, email normalization being load-bearing for invitation matching, token expiry across a 900-second stream, a third concurrent editor on the web app that the collision warning missed, and what a suspended organization does to a turn already in flight.
